<noinclude>
{{OmniFact}} is the reusable fact box used by the article pages of this demo
wiki. It renders one small table row per named parameter, with a positional
fallback for the fact itself.

'''Usage:'''

<pre>{{OmniFact|what=base bundle + web app bundle|where=the workstation service|status=active|source=Projects/Omniagent/Workstation-Standard-Config.md}}</pre>

The positional form is accepted too:

<pre>{{OmniFact|The registry is the single source of truth}}</pre>

Every parameter is optional; an omitted one renders its placeholder.
</noinclude><onlyinclude>{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Fact
| {{{what|{{{1|unspecified}}}}}}
|-
! Where
| {{{where|unspecified}}}
|-
! Status
| {{{status|unknown}}}
|-
! Source page
| {{{source|not recorded}}}
|}</onlyinclude><noinclude>

== Documentation ==

{| class="wikitable"
|-
! Parameter !! Meaning !! Default
|-
| <code>1</code> || Positional fallback for the fact, used when <code>what</code> is omitted || <code>unspecified</code>
|-
| <code>what</code> || The fact this box states || <code>unspecified</code>
|-
| <code>where</code> || Where the fact applies || <code>unspecified</code>
|-
| <code>status</code> || The fact's status, for example <code>active</code>, <code>shipped</code> or <code>retired</code> || <code>unknown</code>
|-
| <code>source</code> || The omniagent wiki path the fact derives from || <code>not recorded</code>
|}

The box is rendered with <code><nowiki>{{OmniFact|...}}</nowiki></code> in an
article; the documentation you are reading is wrapped in
<code>&lt;noinclude&gt;</code> and the box itself in
<code>&lt;onlyinclude&gt;</code>, so only the table is transcluded.
